query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT p.ref_id, COUNT(r.rating) AS review_count, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.category = r.category AND p.ref_id = r.ref_id WHERE p.category = 'electronics' AND p.price > 50 GROUP BY p.ref_id HAVING COUNT(r.rating) >= 5 AND AVG(r.rating) < 3.0)
